text:
Ayla: Quick one — FinNova (EU fintech) wants a temporary per-token ceiling for a 3-mo hosted POC. Their projected burst is ~150M tokens/mo. Asking to drop hosted rate from $0.0008 -> $0.00045/token for pilot, and to waive the min charge in month 1.
Sam: Can you confirm workload shape? steady vs spiky matters for batching/cost. Also any data residency needs?
Ayla: Mostly spiky (end-of-day batch + interactive flows). They need EU region, but staying on hosted is fine. No extra compliance asks for POC.
Sam: OK. With bursting that low rate will hit us on shared pools unless we route to a limited dedicated shard for the pilot. Ops estimate: add ~1 GPU reserved window or cap on RPS. That we can do for 90 days.
Jordan: Finance view — what's the revenue math? If we give 0.00045 for 150M tokens/mo -> $67.5k/mo. For 3 months = $202.5k. If we waive min in month 1, acceptable if there's a path to a commit afterwards. We prefer a follow-up conversion metric or commit.
Ayla: Sales propose: 3-mo pilot at $0.00045/token for up to 150M tokens/mo, month 1 min waived, month 2-3 min = $5k/month, and a 12-month conversion target of $1.2M ARR or auto-rate revert.
Maya: Legal — need to confirm exceptions to pricing terms and any SLA promises. If we add a custom min / rate we should capture it in a short amendment: duration, explicit auto-revert, and limits on liability. No major risk flagged but need sign-off on amendment text.
Jordan: Conditional approval from finance if: 1) pilot cap of 150M tokens/mo explicitly listed; 2) auto-revert to standard $0.0008 after 90 days; 3) conversion language / optional commit (we prefer firm commit but accept KPI-based conversion); 4) payment terms net30 + PO.
Ayla: I can get PO and exec email from customer. Sales will own conversion. Can legal draft a 1-paragraph amendment?
Maya: Yes, I'll draft a short amendment and ping legal-approvals. Include clause: "Temporary rate applies only to tokens consumed within EU hosted region; any cross-region or private deployment excluded."
Sam: Ops notes — we should create a short-lived routing rule: route FinNova token traffic to a reserved pool with throttles to avoid noisy-neighbor issues. Also set per-minute token cap so unexpected spikes don't blow budget.
Ayla: Thanks. Can someone create the deal desk ticket / record? We need the ticket id on the amendment.
deploy-bot: Approval request created: PRIC-4587. Assigned to Jordan, Maya.
Jordan: I'll add finance approval to PRIC-4587 conditional on the conversion language.
Maya: Draft done, uploaded to PRIC-4587: amendment text attached.
Ayla: Final ask: can we accept the temporary $0.00045 rate for the 90-day pilot with the above conditions? If yes I'll route PO + get customer signature.
Jordan: Finance sign-off given the conversion target is added (we agreed to 1.2M ARR or KPI-trigger).
Maya: Legal sign-off on amendment; no additional redlines.
Sam: Ops ready to configure routing and per-minute caps once ticket has final PO and customer org id. Expect ~48h lead time to provision.
Ayla: Great — I'll send PO tonight and update PRIC-4587. I'll post final customer confirmation here when received. :thumbsup:
